$comment: Mall-side plugin manifest. Config-template plugin: ships a `setup-enterprise-stack` skill + `/alex-act-enterprise setup-enterprise` command that print the .github/copilot/settings.json block for 7 public Microsoft ecosystem plugins by default, with an explicit --user opt-in for ~/.copilot/settings.json. Every target plugin is public — any tenant with the corresponding Microsoft subscription can enable them. Growth uses evidence-gated Steward proposals per Alex_ACT_Steward/architecture/act/CURATION-RULES.md.
description: Alex ACT config-template plugin for the public Microsoft ecosystem — Azure, Fabric (consumption, skills, operations, authoring), Power BI, and M365 Agents Toolkit. Ships a single scaffolding skill (`setup-enterprise-stack`) that generates the `.github/copilot/settings.json` block for the 7 target plugins by default, with `--user` as an explicit opt-in. Every entry is public and works for any tenant with the corresponding Microsoft subscription. Composes alongside `alex-act-core` (public baseline discipline) and `alex-act-illustrator-plugin` (visual authoring).

prerequisites.microsoft_tenant: Any tenant with the target Microsoft subscriptions (Azure, Fabric workspace, M365)

verify_install.$comment: Verify the installed plugin reports this version, exposes one skill and the namespaced setup-enterprise command, and keeps the repo-scope default. Steward's constellation integration suite enforces source, payload, namespace, scope, and downstream plugin contracts.

mall.$comment: Public Mall entry — target marketplace is `alex-mall` (github: fabioc-aloha/Alex_Skill_Mall). No private-tenant dependencies.
